verdict.rationale: Blink Shell provides robust SSH/Mosh connectivity that persists across network changes and device sleep, plus a full terminal environment (docs-2, docs-3, docs-14, docs-15) — enabling a developer to log into a remote box and run git/gh commands to review PRs while mobile. However, the evidence never mentions git, GitHub CLI, or any PR-specific tooling; it only shows generic file-transfer/coding-editor integrations (VS Code, Codespaces) and basic shell utilities like cat/grep/wc, none of which demonstrate PR review specifically. Missing for 10: explicit git/gh CLI support or workflow documentation, evidence of reviewing diffs/PRs on a small touch screen, and any community confirmation of doing PR reviews via Blink.
